resolution: The case keeps moving (`MovesIn`, a present reduction from potency to act), causing a perfection (`CausesIn`, with 'cause of being' at esse) and simple priority (`PriorSimply`, DEF-SIMPLE-PRIORITY) as separate predicates, and every passage between them is an explicit premise: STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-CAUSE-OF-BEING (open, bare) from simple priority to cause of being; STMT-EVERY-CREATED-AGENT-ACTS-AS-APPLIED-TO-ACT-BY-GOD (sourced, q.105 a.5: an agent whose being God causes is itself moved when it moves) linking causing being and moving; STMT-DIRECTING-IS-MOVING for the quinta via. Aristotle's four modes classify causes in general and are not premises of the root path. SCG I.13’s cause of coming to be (CausesOrigin) is recorded separately from moving in a respect or causing a perfection; the finite-past result does not identify its cause as God. For the esse-to-perfections transfer investigation, coming-to-be, continuing existential causation, primary concurrence and secondary production are distinguished in docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md (read pinned q.104 a.1 and q.105 a.5 translations). CausesIn remains effective causal responsibility; necessity of an enabling condition is not by definition such responsibility. Universal esse scope is not identified with God or priority in every causal order. The #487 route bridge adds two passages into the world-relative selected relation of a Profile, each an explicit open premise: STMT-NECESSITY-CAUSES-ARE-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUNDS from cause of necessity, and STMT-SIMPLY-PRIOR-IS-ACTUAL-CONCRETE-GROUND from simple priority. Neither identifies that relation with moving, causing a perfection or Ontic.Causes. Sense fork (docs/notes/load-bearing-terms.md): TruthCore.Causality.TermSenseForks relates the senses instead of keeping them as silos. CauseSense enumerates moving, efficient causing, causing a perfection and cause of origin; CauseFrame.CausesBy unfolds each to MovesIn, EfficientlyCausesIn, CausesIn and CausesOrigin. Coverage (STMT-CAUSE-SENSES-EXHAUSTIVE) and exclusivity of the route's reading (STMT-CAUSE-SENSE-UNIQUE) are explicit OPEN frontier premises; with both, every use of 'cause' on a route stands for one relation (CAUSE-ROUTE-USES-AGREE-FROM-UNIQUE-SENSE). CAUSE-SENSE-FORK-NO-SELF-EFFICIENT-CAUSE reaches STMT-NOTHING-IS-EFFICIENT-CAUSE-OF-ITSELF by cases: efficient directly, moving and origin through open bridges, perfection refuted by a self-perfecting subject (SELF-PERFECTING-SUBJECT-REFUTES-NO-SELF-PERFECTION). Grounding and Aristotle's formal, material and final causes are outside the coverage and are the named attacks on it.
